snippet.title: Pale Static (formerly Echoes of the Lost) — Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Echoes of the Lost has been renamed Pale Static.** It is the same game under a new title; its story, gameplay and development plans remain unchanged. This teaser was originally published before the rename, so the former title appears in the video.

Wishlist Pale Static on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5162960/Pale_Static/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announce_sep2026&utm_content=announcement_teaser

The town went quiet before the squad arrived.

Pale Static is a single-player cinematic survival horror built in Unreal Engine 5.8.

You play as Rook, entering a quarantined American town with a private response squad after communications go silent. Search abandoned streets, conserve ammunition and medical supplies, and uncover what happened as the operation falls apart.

This announcement teaser features footage from the current development build. Visuals, audio and gameplay are still being refined.

A free demo is in development. Chapter 1 is planned as the first Early Access release.

Developed by Veilgrain.

#PaleStatic #SurvivalHorror #IndieGame #UnrealEngine
